sentences.text:
THE STATE OF HARYANA Petitio  VERSUS  RAM GOPAL Respondent(s)
 (IA No. 179695/2018 - EXEMPTION FROM FILING C/C OF THE IMPUGNED  JUDGMENT)
 Date : 09-01-2020
These matters were called on for hearing today.

CORAM :
 HON'BLE MRS. JUSTICE R. BANUMATHI  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE A.S. BOPANNA  For Petitioner(s) Mr. Amit Kumar,Adv.
 Mr. Vishwa Pal Singh, AOR  For Respondent(s) Mr. Prakash Ranjan Nayak, AOR
UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R
We have heard learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner-State of Haryana and perused the relevant material.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, we are not inclined to interfere with the acquittal of the respondent under section 16 read with Section 7 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954.
The special leave petition is, accordingly, dismissed.
Pending application(s), if any, shall also stand disposed of.
